scope.interactionChannel: real macOS secondary mouse click via cliclick

snapshot.source: isolated copy of the Electron showcase environment

observations.name: secondary click opens native menu
observations.detail: A real secondary click on the active thread card traverses Lynx main-thread mousedown button=2, the capability bridge, and Main Process Menu.popup. The visible macOS menu contains Settle thread, Rename thread, Copy path, Copy branch, Archive, a destructive separator, and Delete. No action was selected.

classification.closedProductLoss: Thread secondary click now opens a system-native menu instead of a renderer-drawn context overlay.
remainingProductLoss: Unread and Move to project are not yet represented because those commands are not exposed by the current Lynx thread action contract.
Rename and Delete intentionally continue into the existing Lynx input and confirmation surfaces after native selection.
missingCoverage: Light theme and settled-thread variants are not retained in this slice.
Menu item selection outcomes are covered by the host unit test, not by destructive physical input in this retained run.
classification.harnessLoss: Lynxtron 0.0.16 did not register an owned DevTool client, so the screenshot is window-server evidence and no DevTool console or exact LynxView geometry credit is claimed.
classification.intentionalPlatformDelta: The macOS menu uses native platform material and metrics rather than matching Web overlay pixels.

policy: The state entered the fixed model before repair credit. No existing weight, threshold, filter, or residual was reduced.
